verdict.rationale: GitHub Mobile's own page documents Copilot inside the app. It can provide insights into your public and private repositories in natural language, and Copilot code review analyzes pull requests and suggests improvements from your phone. Supporting docs add that review feedback includes suggested changes you can apply. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation of the AI insight features on mobile, and in-depth mobile-specific documentation (the detailed docs describe GitHub.com rather than the mobile app).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: provide insights into both public and your private repositories
Let Copilot code review analyze your pull requests and suggest improvements right from your phone.
Where possible, Copilot's feedback includes suggested changes which you can apply with a couple of clicks.
